title: 🤖 2026年5月17日 AI 技术日报
summary: 本期AI技术演进呈现“推理范式重构”与“生成一致性攻坚”双主线。测试时计算从深度搜索转向并行广度采样与概率聚合，显著降低对单一验证器的依赖；视觉与3D生成聚焦隐状态推理与原生空间编辑，突破传统2D升维与外部工具调用的延迟瓶颈。多模态评测向长序列实体一致性与几何合理性深化，科学计算大模型通过稀疏路由解决异构负迁移。整体趋势表明，AI正从规模堆叠迈向架构解耦与精细化控制，工程落地更强调低延迟、高一致性与可验证推理。

highlights.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash means LLM steering is interesting again
highlights.analysis: 原理：通过干预Transformer隐藏层激活向量引导模型输出，无需参数微调。创新：轻量化模型证明低算力下线性探针即可实现精细控制，大幅降低干预成本。应用：实时安全过滤、动态角色设定、在线对齐补丁部署。

Existing evaluations typically use independently generated prompt sets with limited entity coverage and simple consistency metrics, making standardized comparison difficult. highlights.analysis: 原理：针对多镜头视频实体一致性难题，构建真实叙事媒体基准，提供显式标注与跨镜头度量。创新：突破单提示词评估局限，引入长序列叙事逻辑与细粒度指标。应用：影视AI制作、长视频剧情生成、虚拟IP一致性维护。

highlights.title: ATLAS: Agentic or Latent Visual Reasoning? One Word is Enough for Both
highlights.summary: Visual reasoning, often interleaved with intermediate visual states, has emerged as a promising direction in the field. A straightforward approach is to directly generate images via unified models during reasoning, but this is computationally expensive and architecturally non-trivial. Recent alternatives include agentic reasoning through code or tool calls, and latent reasoning with learnable hidden embeddings. highlights.analysis: 原理：提出统一视觉推理范式，通过极少量中间状态在隐空间与工具调用间切换，避免外部执行延迟。创新：将显式状态压缩为可学习嵌入，结合轻量解码平衡计算效率与推理深度。应用：移动端视觉问答、实时机器人感知、低延迟多模态部署。

highlights.title: VGGT-Edit: Feed-forward Native 3D Scene Editing with Residual Field Prediction
highlights.summary: High-quality 3D scene reconstruction has recently advanced toward generalizable feed-forward architectures, enabling the generation of complex environments in a single forward pass. However, despite their strong performance in static scene perception, these models remain limited in responding to dynamic human instructions, which restricts their use in interactive applications. highlights.analysis: 原理：基于前馈3D重建架构，通过预测残差场直接响应编辑指令，摒弃独立视图升维流水线。创新：原生支持3D空间端到端编辑，保证全局一致性，单次前向传播完成修改。应用：交互式3D创作、数字孪生更新、AR/VR场景构建。

highlights.title: Eradicating Negative Transfer in Multi-Physics Foundation Models via Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing
highlights.summary: Scaling Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) toward universal foundation models is bottlenecked by negative transfer: the simultaneous co-training of disparate partial differential equation (PDE) regimes can induce gradient conflict, unstable optimization, and plasticity loss in dense neural operators. highlights.analysis: 原理：针对多物理场联合训练的梯度冲突，引入稀疏MoE路由，为异构物理谱分配专属专家。创新：有效解耦不同流体介质需求，消除负迁移，提升稠密算子优化稳定性。应用：科学计算大模型、复杂工程仿真、多尺度气候预测。

highlights.title: OpenDeepThink: Parallel Reasoning via Bradley--Terry Aggregation
highlights.summary: Test-time compute scaling is a primary axis for improving LLM reasoning. Existing methods primarily scale depth by extending a single reasoning trace. Scaling breadth by sampling multiple candidates in parallel is straightforward, but introduces a selection bottleneck: choosing the best candidate without a ground-truth verifier, since pointwise LLM judging is noisy and biased. highlights.analysis: 原理：测试时计算扩展中并行采样多条推理链，利用Bradley-Terry模型进行成对比较聚合。创新：解决无验证器下的选择瓶颈，以概率排序替代绝对打分，提升鲁棒性。应用：复杂逻辑推理、自动化代码验证、高可靠AI决策。

测试时并行推理结合成对比较聚合，标志着LLM推理优化正从启发式搜索转向概率排序决策，降低对完美Reward Model的依赖。
